::: {.callout-note}
## What this is

A working analysis, not a finished study. Every candidate here is a prediction from sequence
and structure; none has been expressed or assayed. Section 10 of the report states the
limitations explicitly, and the section headed *Upstream issues found* records problems located
in reference data rather than in this analysis.

The source of truth is
[`analysis/mucor_secretome/`](https://github.com/1KFG/delta-gain-fungi/tree/main/analysis/mucor_secretome)
in the repository; this page renders `REPORT.md` from that directory, so the two cannot drift.
:::
